sources.entry: Parry-guard by vaporif - Prompt injection scanner for AI coding tool hooks, written in Rust. Catches injection attacks, leaked secrets, and data exfiltration in tool inputs and outputs by running DeBERTa v3 and optionally Meta Llama Prompt Guard 2 locally via Candle. Built for Claude Code hooks; the models are gated on HuggingFace, so installation requires accepting their licences first. Self-desc

summary.one_liner: A Rust prompt-injection scanner that runs as a hook for Claude Code (and Codex or other command-hook tools), checking tool inputs and outputs for injection attacks, leaked secrets, and data exfiltration using locally run ML models.
keywords: protect agent from malicious tool output
block dangerous shell commands from ai agent
use_cases: Protecting Claude Code sessions from prompt injection in files, web pages, and tool output
Blocking data exfiltration attempts in agent Bash commands
Detecting leaked secrets in tool inputs and outputs
Auditing .claude/ directory permissions and hook scripts
Batch scanning diffs with the full ML model set
how_to_run: Accept the DeBERTa v3 licence (and Llama Prompt Guard 2 for full mode) on HuggingFace and create an access token
Or with uvx: add a PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit hook running "uvx parry-guard hook" to ~/.claude/settings.json
stack: Meta Llama Prompt Guard 2 86M (optional, full mode)
notable: Runs ML classifiers locally via ONNX or Candle, with a detached daemon and a 30-day scan result cache
Layered detection: Unicode checks, substring matching, 40+ secret regexes, ML classification, and tree-sitter Bash exfiltration analysis
Fails closed: content it cannot classify is treated as unsafe
Scan modes fast, full, and custom, with user-defined models and patterns files
Works with Claude Code, Codex, and any runner that sends the same JSON hook payloads
caveats: Described by the author as early development; expect bugs and false positives; tested only on Linux and macOS
ML models are gated on HuggingFace and require accepting licences and a token before use
Full mode needs the candle backend and is about 20x slower per chunk; Llama Prompt Guard 2 has its own Llama 4 Community License
summary.license: MIT (Llama Prompt Guard 2 used in full mode has the separate Llama 4 Community License)
